stem.en: A truck driver moving at 54 km/h sees a speed limit sign and slows down evenly to 36 km/h in 36 s. What distance does the truck travel in those 36 s, in m?

explanation.en: 54 km/h = 15 m/s and 36 km/h = 10 m/s. The acceleration is constant, so s = 1/2 (u + v) t = 1/2 x (15 + 10) x 36 = 450 m. The area under the velocity-time line gives the same answer.

hints.en: Change both speeds into m/s first.
